تحتملين (form VIII)
# تَحْتَمِلِينَ (taḥtamilīna) /taħ.ta.mi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# تُحْتَمَلِينَ (tuḥtamalīna) /tuħ.ta.ma.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
